title: BrainiLab: first 200 completed recorded games
selection: First 200 completed game sessions with a recorded result, ordered by completion time and a stable tie-break. Snapshot checked 23 October 2026.
method: Sum of verified correct answers divided by sum of verified counted answers; round to one decimal place. Repeated rounds count separately. The three comparison games account for 44 of the 90 eligible rounds.
limitations: Only completed recorded rounds; not visits or unfinished games.
Different players, question sets, difficulties and game rules; not matched tests.
Known administration accounts excluded; other test accounts may remain.
Math Rush skips excluded from its answer denominator.
Versions changed during the period; most eligible Math Rush rounds use its newer scoring version.
Self-selected small sample; not evidence of population abilities, learning gains or intelligence.
privacy: Aggregates only; no player names, identifiers, contact details or individual results.
